name: Corn chip (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Corn chip [Snack foods] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy, 'Snacks, corn-based, extruded, chips, plain', FDC ID 167537 - full measured nutrient panel incl. amino acids, individual sugars, fatty acids, phytosterols, vitamins, minerals (primary source for all quantified values)
USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy, 'Snacks, corn-based, extruded, chips, unsalted', FDC ID 168127 - cross-check of the same matrix
Nardi et al. 2024, Molecules 29:4097, doi:10.3390/molecules29174097 (PMC11397060) - quantitative maize-grain organic acids and free sugars (NMR metabolomics)
Urizar & Bressani 1997 phytate-in-nixtamal data, reviewed in Felix-Samano et al., Int J Food Sci 2025, doi:10.1155/ijfo/6961009 - phytic-acid estimate
provenance.curation_notes: DOMINANT carbon/energy source is STARCH (~51 g/100g); free sugars are trivial (sucrose 0.27 g; glucose/fructose/maltose/lactose/galactose all 0). Because the food is UNFERMENTED, the classic organic acids are only trace - the one substantial acid is phytate (~0.7 g/100g), which also binds most of the phosphorus/mineral pool; small citric/malic/acetic/succinic/lactic pools were added from peer-reviewed maize data (FooDB listed no organic acids). Protein (6.17 g/100g) is maize zein/glutelin (gluta
curation_added: starch quantified as the DOMINANT carbon source (~51.4 g/100g)
organic acids: phytic (~0.7 g) plus small citric/malic/acetic/succinic/formic/lactic from peer-reviewed maize NMR data (FooDB had listed none)
L-phenylalanine and L-valine (both missing from the current FooDB amino-acid list); full measured amino-acid profile
corrected L-serine (FooDB record had non-biological D-serine)
quantified individual fatty acids (linoleic-dominant corn oil) and long-chain saturates
quantified full mineral panel (Na, Cl, K, P, Ca, Mg, Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn, Se, F)
quantified full vitamin panel; vitamin E corrected to 7.23 mg + gamma-tocopherol 17.8 mg; beta-cryptoxanthin added
genuine phytosterols with measured amounts (see keep_uncovered)

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: Zero in a plant + vegetable-oil food (USDA measured 0 mg); FooDB animal-sterol artifact.

curation_removed.name: Lactose C12H22O11
curation_removed.reason: No dairy in a corn/oil/salt product; USDA measured 0 g. Implausible.

curation_removed.name: D-Galactose
curation_removed.reason: USDA measured 0 g; no galactose source in corn+oil+salt. Absent.

curation_removed.name: Maltose C12H22O11
curation_removed.reason: USDA measured 0 g free maltose in the finished chip (starch not hydrolyzed). Absent.

curation_removed.name: Hexanoate (n-C6:0)
curation_removed.reason: C6:0 = 0.0 g (USDA). Short/medium-chain FA of coconut/palm-kernel/dairy fat, not corn frying oil. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Octanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: C8:0 = 0.01 g trace (USDA); coconut/palm-kernel marker, not a real corn-oil component. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Decanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: C10:0 = 0.004 g trace (USDA); MCFA not characteristic of corn oil. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Dodecanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: C12:0 (lauric) = 0.001 g trace (USDA); coconut/palm-kernel marker, absent in corn-oil chip. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: Stereochemistry artifact; biological serine in corn protein is L-serine (kept as L-serine).

curation_removed.name: Cyanocobalamin
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin B12 = 0 in a plant food (USDA). No real cobalamin content.

curation_removed.name: Vitamin D
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin D = 0 (USDA); not a nutrient of an unfortified corn snack.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed retinol = 0 in a plant food (USDA); provitamin-A carotenoids only.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Free cobalt ion; non-nutritive trace, B12 = 0 so no functional cobalamin pool. Not a growth nutrient of this food.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive trace contaminant, not a corn-chip growth nutrient.

basis: per 100 g as consumed (fried, salted corn chip; ~1% moisture)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
